name: Solar Step
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: square fantasy MMO ability icon, readable at 24 pixels in color and grayscale. Create an original 2D painted icon for Solar Step, a paladin ability that briefly increases movement speed. Show one large bright ivory and gold armored boot moving diagonally toward the upper right, a clear broad golden speed streak trailing behind and a simple small sunburst behind the heel. Keep the boot silhouette light and fully distinct against dark navy and charcoal; bold contrast and simple value groups, warm golden holy light, textured hand-painted fantasy game art. Reference image is for painterly style and palette only; do not reproduce its sword or composition. Full bleed, no person, text, letters, numbers, outer frame, logo or watermark.

reference.role: Style and palette reference only, prior generated Whetstorm pilot. Rights and release clearance not independently verified.

generatedSource.description: Built-in generated PNG, byte-identical to master

processing: Pillow RGB Lanczos resize to 128x128, WebP quality 90 method 6; previews from candidate resized using Lanczos to 24 or 32 pixels, grayscale via Pillow grayscale and nearest-neighbor enlargement 10x.

gamePilotContext.note: Separate experimental game checkout; not a delivery in the art repository.

status: Experimental pilot candidate. Independent static 24px grayscale review completed. Solar Step boot and trail overlap, and movement meaning is contextual. Gameplay review, rights assessment and release clearance remain pending; hashes do not establish rights.
